seo.title: Digitalize your campsite catering
seo.description: Improve your campsite management with digital catering. Save time and increase revenue. :point_up: Discover our ecosystem

fields.text-17px-html: Offer your guests quick and easy access to food and beverages by streamlining your service and reducing waiting times at your point of sale.
fields.expertise-img-alt: QR code to order at the campsite
fields.subtitle-hover-block-html: Give your guests the freedom to order from the comfort of their pitch, without having to queue. Thanks to digital order-taking and an integrated loyalty program, the experience is seamless and personalized, even in high season.
fields.title50px-2: Manage the restoration of your campsite
fields.subtitle-hover-block-html-2: Simplify snack cash-out with a cash register that centralizes all your orders. Make your menus accessible via QR codes, track your sales in real time and increase your average basket with intelligent additional sales.
fields.subtitle-hover-block-html-3: Offer your campers a seamless experience, from payment to order collection. Easily pay on site, at the bar or snack bar, whatever the method of payment. Thanks to real-time tracking, your campers receive a notification as soon as their order is ready, telling them where to pick it up (counter, directly on the table...).

fields.accordion-title-solutions-html: How does take-away or table service work for campers?
fields.rt-faq-html: Each table or zone is equipped with a unique QR code. Campers scan it with their smartphone to access a personalized ordering interface, with no app to download. They can view the map, order and pay directly from their phone.
fields.rt-faq-html-2: Innovorder offers a suite of solutions designed to cope with the complex flows and peak use of campsites. Central checkout, autonomous ordering, mobile payment: everything is synchronized, fluid and customizable. You gain in productivity, your guests spend less time waiting, and your sales naturally increase.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-3: Can I track my sales and performance in real time?
fields.rt-faq-html-3: Yes, the Innovorder back-office lets you monitor your sales, by zone or by product, in real time. You can visualize your performance, adjust your teams or your offer according to traffic, and manage your entire site remotely.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-4: What solutions are available to equip my campsite?
fields.rt-faq-html-4:
Innovorder offers an ecosystem tailored to the specific needs of campsites:

  • Cash register: manage your orders simultaneously from a single tool, even at peak times. Cash in anywhere in your campsite with our mobile cash register.
  • Order at the table via QR code: your customers can order directly from their seats, streamlining service and boosting sales.
  • Order kiosk: ideal at the entrance, near the snack bar or directly on the activity site, to capture independent orders and avoid queues.
  • Production display (KDS): instantly displays orders in the kitchen or at the bar, for faster, error-free service.
fields.accordion-title-solutions-html-5: Can I connect my Innovorder to a reservation system or RFID wristband?
fields.rt-faq-html-5: No, the Innovorder cash register is dedicated to catering management only. It does not manage campsite reservations. Our solution focuses on cash collection, order taking and smooth service within your catering space.
